# Upgrade Your Institution with Human Anatomy VR

**Why Choose Human Anatomy VR?** - Utilize a comprehensive and highly detailed anatomical XR tool, trusted and adopted by **top universities**, healthcare organizations, and professionals in over *180 countries*.

This application requires an **active subscription** to unlock features.

**Subscription Levels:**
- Student
- Educator
- Professional
- Institution

**Key Features:**

- **Interactive Learning:** Host multi-user, cross-platform sessions with up to 100 participants. 
{1022341832369269}

- **Advanced DICOM Imaging:** Transform CT/MRI scans into 3D models with our VR DICOM module. 
{1058954758917488}

- **Extensive Anatomy Library:** Explore 15 body systems and over 13,000 anatomical structures.
{1418662452153040}

- **Ant-Mode:** Allows you to shrink down in size up to 40x and observe the human body from a completely different perspective.
{1409897293028158}

**And much more!**

- **3D Cadaver Images:** Access a vast collection for realistic study created in cooperation with Stanford University. 
- **Detailed Bone Mapping:** Includes 5000 bony features for in-depth study.
- **Microanatomy Models:** 21 detailed models with explanatory information.
- **Dynamic Animations:** Over 500 movement animations for a better understanding of body mechanics.
- **Interactive Learning Tools:** In-app anatomy quizzes.
- And much more!


**Free Trial:** Experience full access to the application with our 24-hour free trial.

**Upgrade now** and bring an immersive, intuitive VR tool for anatomical visualization to your institution

changelog.change_log:
Performance:
- Improved performance after loading saves.

New Features:
- Added the ability to pin objects for easier identification and manipulation.
- Added labels for controllers on Quest 3 and Quest 3S.
- Toggle hand menu panels (models/tools) using the X button.
- Full body scaling using double grab.
- Ability to move and rotate the entire body within the room.
- Added the option to display the original text for translations on the info panel.
- Added new languages: Polish and Finnish.

AntMode Improvements:
- Automatic breakdown of complex objects into more detailed parts.
- Improved highlight colors for a better visual experience.
- Updated info monitor content only after pressing the trigger.

UI and Settings:
- Redesigned layout of the info panel.
- Added the option to adjust skin tones in the login scene.

Fixes:
- Fixed a visual bug when a detail part returned to its place.
- Fixed the issue with hiding and showing objects through rapid clicking.
- Fixed incorrect voice-over in the tutorial.

Institution Only
- Added slice plane positioning in individual axes.
- Quick settings panel for students: change language, skin tones, and movement type.
- Fixed cadaver images that could not be opened.

- Fixed labels for the microanatomy layers of the skin.
- Added new languages: Ukrainian, Russian, Korean, and Japanese.
- Implemented functionality to fix the XYZ axis while slicing DICOM.
- Added the option to open PDF files via the web browser.
- Improved female models.
- Minor bug fixes.

New Features:
- Quiz Select Feature (Essential License only)
 
Improvements:
- Sci-fi Environment optimization
- Digestive system cut mode
- Enhanced "Report Improvement" panel
- Various Small 3D models improvements
 
Bug Fixes:
- Various minor bug fixes
Improved descriptions of anatomical structures in the Czech language.

**New Features:** - New female models for university content - New female models for high school content - Improvement suggestion panel added - New interface and content languages **Enhancements:** - Visual laser pointer improved - Minor adjustments to male models - Web search optimization **Bug Fixes:** - Various minor bug fixes

Significant improvement in FPS,
UI language fixes,
Improved UI layout of web tests,
Added questionnaire,
New login UI,
Minor bug fixes.
